name: HiveMind
notes: Update now works again: the box shows the download filling up, with a percentage.
You can leave HiveMind while it downloads; the box stays, and Android asks to update as soon as you're back.
If the download stops (no signal), Try again is right there.
Inspecting a hive that's already recorded as a dead-out now says so at the top.
Inspection sections now start with a solid gold heading band, easy to spot while scrolling.
The update box always fits on the screen now, with its buttons in sight.
Settings › 🧪 Test yards: adds three made-up apiaries with numbered hives to try everything on (your own hives aren't touched).
🔍 Inspect right from where a hive is shown: Home's hive list, alerts and reminders, the apiary page, and the top of each hive's page.
One number per apiary: a new hive can't share a living hive's number. Reuse a dead-out's number and the old one is renamed, e.g. "Hive 3 (dead-out Oct 2026)".
